title: Settings

theme.title: Theme
theme.body: Light is the default — a white content area with black and gold text. Dark restores the Sovereign Agentic brand palette (gold #c8a24a on #0c0b0d). The navigation stays dark in both modes. Your choice is saved on this device.

technical.title: Show technical details
technical.body: Off by default. Switch it on to see the engineering panels on detail pages, such as Under the hood. Your choice is saved on this device.

language.title: Language
language.body: The language of the whole OS for you, and the language the AI answers you in. Your own content — dataset names, files, knowledge — stays as you wrote it. Saved to your account, on every device.
